-- template.gohtml --
{{- define "POST /save htmx(Save(ctx, form))" -}}{{.HXRedirect "/next"}}saved:{{- .Result -}}{{- end -}}
{{- define "GET /state htmx(State(ctx))" -}}{{- if .HXRequest -}}from-htmx boosted={{ .HXBoosted }}{{- else -}}plain{{- end -}}{{- end -}}
-- go.mod --
module server

go 1.24
-- template.go --
package server

import (
	"context"
	"embed"
	"html/template"
	"net/url"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templatesFS embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templatesFS, "*"))

type Server struct{}

// Save handles a form post whose template steers the htmx client with an
// HX-Redirect response header after success.
func (Server) Save(_ context.Context, form url.Values) (string, error) {
	return form.Get("name"), nil
}

// State renders differently for htmx-originated requests; the template reads
// the HX-Request and HX-Boosted request headers.
func (Server) State(_ context.Context) (string, error) { return "", nil }
-- template_test.go --
package server

import (
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func Test(t *testing.T) {
	mux := http.NewServeMux()
	TemplateRoutes(mux, Server{})

	t.Run("template sets the HX-Redirect response header", func(t *testing.T) {
		req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, "/save", strings.NewReader("name=ada"))
		req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/x-www-form-urlencoded")
		rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
		mux.ServeHTTP(rec, req)
		if got, want := rec.Header().Get("HX-Redirect"), "/next"; got != want {
			t.Errorf("HX-Redirect = %q, want %q", got, want)
		}
		if !strings.Contains(rec.Body.String(), "saved:ada") {
			t.Errorf("body = %q, want it to contain %q", rec.Body.String(), "saved:ada")
		}
	})

	t.Run("template reads htmx request headers", func(t *testing.T) {
		req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/state", nil)
		req.Header.Set("HX-Request", "true")
		req.Header.Set("HX-Boosted", "true")
		rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
		mux.ServeHTTP(rec, req)
		if want := "from-htmx boosted=true"; rec.Body.String() != want {
			t.Errorf("body = %q, want %q", rec.Body.String(), want)
		}
	})
}
